weeks.label: Week 0
weeks.title: Foundation modules
weeks.description: Self-paced modules across all four tracks, sent from August 25 or within 48 hours of enrolling, so new students start level with returning ones.

sessions.title: Algebra Foundations (Pre-Work)
sessions.description: Builds arithmetic fluency and word-problem setup: order of operations, nested fractions, grouping symbols, absolute value, and negatives; translating word problems into equations, including rate/distance/time and money/unit conversions; and percent change, successive percentage changes, and percent vs. percentage points.

sessions.title: Geometry Foundations (Pre-Work)
sessions.description: Covers the geometry toolkit every later lecture assumes: vertical, supplementary, and complementary angles; parallel lines cut by a transversal; area and perimeter formulas for standard shapes; the Pythagorean theorem and common triples (3-4-5, 5-12-13, 8-15-17); and the triangle inequality.

sessions.title: Combinatorics Foundations (Pre-Work)
sessions.description: Introduces counting fundamentals: inclusive counting (b - a + 1), counting multiples of k in a range, the multiplication principle, factorial notation, and basic permutations of distinct objects.

sessions.title: Number Theory Foundations (Pre-Work)
sessions.description: Covers the standard divisibility tests for 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, and 11, plus the basics of number theory: prime vs. composite, factor trees, prime factorization, and GCD/LCM by listing and by factorization.

sessions.title: Diagnostic Practice Test Review
sessions.description: Review of the diagnostic practice test, taken on your own beforehand under exam conditions. This is the starting number we measure against.

sessions.title: Factoring, Identities and Symmetric Expressions
sessions.description: Difference of squares, sum/difference of cubes, perfect-square trinomials, and factoring by grouping, plus symmetric identities like a^2 + b^2 = (a+b)^2 - 2ab used to skip expansion entirely.

sessions.title: Angle Chasing Full: Circles + Isosceles Triangles + Sum 180 degrees
sessions.description: The angle sum of a triangle is 180 degrees, and equal angles in a triangle mean equal side lengths; the inscribed angle theorem and its corollaries (an angle inscribed in a semicircle is 90 degrees); central vs. inscribed angles; the cyclic quadrilateral angle sum; and using radii to build isosceles triangles inside circle diagrams.

sessions.title: Counting and Smart Casework Review
sessions.description: Building exhaustive, non-overlapping cases, recognizing when a direct formula beats casework, and a first pass at complementary counting (total minus bad).

sessions.title: Modular Arithmetic
sessions.description: Congruence notation and arithmetic under a modulus, using mod to find units digits and remainders quickly, the machinery behind the Week 0 divisibility rules.

sessions.title: Week 2 Problem Solving Session
sessions.description: Solve various problems and review techniques.

sessions.title: Algebraic Manipulation I: Telescoping, Solving Systems, Exponents
sessions.description: Telescoping sums and products by cancelling differences, solving 2- and 3-variable systems by substitution and elimination, and exponent laws including negative and fractional exponents.

sessions.title: Similarity & Congruency
sessions.description: SSS/SAS/ASA/AAS congruence and AA/SAS/SSS similarity, the fact that area ratio equals the square of the side ratio, and setting up proportions directly from a diagram.

sessions.title: Probability Review
sessions.description: The favorable-over-total framework, independent vs. dependent events, and complementary probability, folding in the counting tools from Weeks 0-1 rather than treating probability as a separate subject.

sessions.title: Factors and Prime Number Thinking
sessions.description: Prime factorization as the master tool, the divisor-count formula, and the sum-of-divisors formula, used to answer "how many/which factors" questions quickly.

sessions.title: Week 3 Test Review
sessions.description: Review the week's practice test.

sessions.title: Inequalities: Basic Intuitions & Rules, AM-GM
sessions.description: Rules for manipulating inequalities, including the sign flip on multiplying by a negative; the AM-GM inequality and its equality condition; and using AM-GM to bound sums and products in optimization-flavored problems.

sessions.title: Coordinate Geometry
sessions.description: Distance and midpoint formulas, slope and line equations, intersecting lines and circles algebraically, and a range of problems solved through coordinate geometry.

sessions.title: Counting with Restrictions, Complement, Arrangements
sessions.description: Adjacent and non-adjacent restrictions, handling "at least one" via complement, circular permutations, and arrangements with repeated elements.

sessions.title: Divisibility
sessions.description: Divisibility inside factorials and products, using divisibility to pin down unknown digits, and combining these with Week 1's modular arithmetic.

sessions.title: Week 4 Problem Solving Session
sessions.description: Solve various problems and review techniques.

sessions.title: Sequences 01
sessions.description: Arithmetic and geometric sequence formulas for the nth term and the sum, telling the two types apart quickly, and a first look at simple recursive definitions.

sessions.title: Area Deep Dive
sessions.description: Area by decomposition and addition/subtraction, the full shoelace formula, shared base/height area-ratio tricks, Heron's formula, trapezoid area, and coordinate-based area intuition.

sessions.title: Logic Problems Deep Dive
sessions.description: Truth-teller/liar puzzles, deductive reasoning, truth tables and implications, and the general language of logical statements.

sessions.title: Digits and Decimal Representation
sessions.description: Digit-sum and mod-9 tricks, place-value algebra for digit word problems, and converting repeating decimals to fractions.

sessions.title: Week 5 Test Review
sessions.description: Review the week's practice test.

sessions.title: Polynomials and Vieta
sessions.description: The definition of a polynomial, Vieta's formulas relating coefficients to the sum and product of roots, building symmetric root-expressions without solving for the roots, the factor and remainder theorems, and graphical thinking about polynomials.

sessions.title: Similarity, Congruency, Area Revisited
sessions.description: Using similarity, congruency, and area techniques together, chaining Week 2's similarity with Week 4's area methods in single problems; this is the "put it all together" week for geometry.

sessions.title: Stars & Bars, Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion, Recursion in Counting
sessions.description: Stars and bars for distributing identical objects into distinct bins, PIE for two- and three-set overlaps and the general alternating-sum pattern, and building a count from smaller cases by setting up and solving a recursive sequence.

sessions.title: Diophantine Equations and Bounding Techniques
sessions.description: Finding integer-only solutions by factoring into a finite set of cases, using parity and inequalities to bound variables, and moving from "compute an answer" to "prove no other solutions exist."

sessions.title: Week 6 Problem Solving Session
sessions.description: Solve various problems and review techniques.

sessions.title: Mean, Median, Mode, Data
sessions.description: How each statistic shifts under data changes, weighted averages, solving for an unknown data point given a target average, and a range of problems that involve these statistics.

sessions.title: Circle Geometry
sessions.description: Power of a point, tangent-line properties, arc length and sector area, tying back to Week 1's inscribed-angle toolkit.

sessions.title: Probability Deep Dive
sessions.description: Conditional probability, geometric probability as a length/area ratio, and probability problems that need casework or PIE from Week 5.

sessions.title: Divisors, Perfect Powers, Factorials
sessions.description: Conditions for an expression to be a perfect square or cube, factorial prime factorization and Legendre's formula for trailing zeros, combining with Week 2's divisor-count formula, and thinking through prime factors when working with perfect powers and factorials.

weeks.label: Week 7
weeks.title: Cumulative theory review, all four tracks

sessions.title: Week 7 Test Review
sessions.description: Review the week's practice test.

sessions.title: Theory Review and Gauss Sums
sessions.description: A cumulative review of everything covered in previous algebra lectures, plus Gauss sums and the ideas that come up around them.

sessions.title: 3D Geometry and Theory Review
sessions.description: Volume and surface area of prisms, pyramids, cones, and spheres; the space diagonal via 3D Pythagoras; cross-sections of solids; then a cumulative review pass over all geometry theory learned so far.

sessions.title: Theory Review, Simple Patterns, Greedy Maximization
sessions.description: Recognizing simple patterns in problems, an introduction to greedy maximization, and a cumulative review of the counting and probability tools covered so far.

sessions.title: Theory Review
sessions.description: A cumulative review of modular arithmetic, divisibility, primes and factorization, digits, and Diophantine/bounding techniques, using mixed problems that force the right choice of tool.

sessions.title: Week 8 Problem Solving Session
sessions.description: Solve various problems and review techniques.

sessions.title: Algebra Problem-Solving Bootcamp
sessions.description: Recognizing the theory behind each problem and working to solve it quickly.

sessions.title: Geometry Problem-Solving Bootcamp
sessions.description: Recognizing the theory behind each problem and working to solve it quickly.

sessions.title: Combinatorics Problem-Solving Bootcamp
sessions.description: Recognizing the theory behind each problem and working to solve it quickly.

sessions.title: Number Theory Problem-Solving Bootcamp
sessions.description: Recognizing the theory behind each problem and working to solve it quickly.
